cron:scheduled:communication-recovery.success_signal: structured log event communication_delivery_dispatch, level info
cron:scheduled:communication-recovery.alert_condition: communication_delivery_dispatch at level error (publish failures, exhausted retry budgets, or oldest pending message older than 30 minutes)

cron:scheduled:cfp-staged-purge.success_signal: structured log event cfp_staged_upload_purge, level info
cron:scheduled:cfp-staged-purge.alert_condition: cfp_staged_upload_purge at level error (R2 delete failures)

cron:scheduled:speaker-pending-upload-pu.success_signal: structured log event speaker_pending_upload_purge, level info
cron:scheduled:speaker-pending-upload-pu.alert_condition: speaker_pending_upload_purge at level error (R2 delete failures)

queue:asset-scan.trigger: queue sessionbuddy-asset-scans (binding ASSET_SCAN_QUEUE), max_retries 5, dead_letter_queue sessionbuddy-asset-scans-dlq
queue:asset-scan.success_signal: none (KNOWN GAP: the consumer acks/retries without structured logs; track via speaker_asset_versions scan_state transitions and DLQ depth)

queue:communication-delivery.trigger: queue sessionbuddy-communications (binding COMMUNICATION_QUEUE), max_retries 5, dead_letter_queue sessionbuddy-communications-dlq
queue:communication-delivery.success_signal: successful sends ack silently; failures emit structured log event communication_delivery_failed (level error, reason=exception class or provider_unconfigured)
queue:communication-delivery.alert_condition: communication_delivery_failed at level error, or growth in sessionbuddy-communications-dlq depth; reason=provider_unconfigured means RESEND_API_KEY/RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS are missing and affected rows are parked failed for requeue-exhausted after configuration is fixed

queue:communication-reminder.trigger: queue sessionbuddy-communications (binding COMMUNICATION_QUEUE), max_retries 5, dead_letter_queue sessionbuddy-communications-dlq
queue:communication-reminder.success_signal: none (KNOWN GAP: reminder consumption acks silently; track reminder_schedules rows)

workflow:ReminderWorkflow.trigger: workflow binding REMINDER_WORKFLOW (wrangler.jsonc workflows, class ReminderWorkflow)
workflow:ReminderWorkflow.success_signal: workflow instance completes; reminder rows advance in reminder_schedules
workflow:ReminderWorkflow.alert_condition: workflow instances failing or stuck in the Cloudflare workflows dashboard

/api/v1/auth/verify.reason: Legacy GET compatibility guard returns 405 only and is intentionally excluded from the published API contract; POST /auth/verify owns redemption telemetry.

/api/v1/cfp/uploads/{staged_id}/content.reason: Local-development-only staged upload sink (APP_ENV=local); never deployed behind production traffic.

/api/v1/uploads/{intent_id}/content.reason: Local-development-only upload sink (APP_ENV=local); never deployed behind production traffic.

/auth/verify.reason: Magic-link confirmation and consumption flow; observed through the identity API entries and auth structured logs, not page web-vitals.
